status: Four complete proposed runnable adaptations; source reviewed, not implemented or performance validated

shared_mapping.nodes: For each valid utterance with available history: Local l; Base b_h for h=0..7; Gap g_m,h only for missing modality m in fixed A,T,V order and h=0..7. 9/17/25 active nodes. Split actual 512-dimensional memory output into its genuine eight 64-dimensional value heads; never reshape arbitrary features into image patches.
shared_mapping.projection: l=Linear256to128(Local)+type_Local; b_h=P_h(Base_h)+type_Base+head_h; g_m,h=P_h(Gap_m,h)+type_m+head_h. Eight P_h:64to128 maps are shared between Base and Gap of the same actual head. Head identities do not imply spatial/temporal proximity.
shared_mapping.hyperedges: Exactly H_h={l,b_h} union {g_m,h: m missing}, h=0..7; T_Base={l,b_0,...,b_7}; T_m={l,g_m,0,...,g_m,7} for each missing m. Total 9/10/11 edges. No duplicate global edge, singleton edge, learned topology, temporal neighbors or labels. Local belongs to every edge and conditions all group communication.
shared_mapping.mask: Remove inactive nodes and incident memberships before projection, normalization or attention; compact graph per utterance or block-diagonal batch. Padded rows return zero branch. No-history rows bypass graph and return original Flat exactly. All-observed with history still has Local and Base graph. Exclude NaN inactive raw slots with where before any arithmetic.
shared_mapping.common_readout: Unless overridden by Hyper-SAGNN, concatenate final Local128, mean of eight Base128, and active Gap mean128 (zero if empty); Linear384to128 then zero-initialized Linear128to1600 additive correction to original Flat pre-normalization. Retain original downstream normalization/head and compute original task loss once.
shared_mapping.protocol: No dropout, BatchNorm, new losses, labels-as-input, memory scan/query/write, persistent node/edge cache, feature completion or RNG sampling in forward. Construct branch under isolated initialization RNG; default-off must instantiate nothing and preserve legacy RNG/output. Same fixed configuration across screening datasets/seeds; validate source equivalence on tiny unmasked graphs before training.
shared_mapping.interpretation: Graph memberships are a proposed evidence organization, not an observed physical hypergraph. These are complete transplanted core blocks with new task embedding/readout, not reproductions of source datasets or objectives.

candidates.title: You are AllSet: A Multiset Learning Framework for Hypergraph Neural Networks
candidates.corechain: Node-to-hyperedge learned-seed multihead pooling, then hyperedge-to-node learned-seed pooling. Each PMA retains key/value transforms, target-group softmax, seed residual, LayerNorm and residual feedforward LayerNorm. Repeat complete V→E→V rounds; not ordinary flat token self-attention.

exact_mapping.parameters: Independent V→E and E→V PMAs in each round, one learned seed per attention head. FFN128→128→128 with ReLU; source PMA uses LeakyReLU(0.2) seed-key scores before grouped softmax. ReLU after each half-round, matching SetGNN backbone. GPR=False, LearnMask=False, dropout=0, no batch normalization.

candidates.why_meaningful: Tests whether content-selective aggregation within actual shared-head groups and evidence-type groups is better than uniformly mixing all already-read evidence. Two full bipartite rounds let a head-specific discrepancy change another group's readout through Local.
candidates.distinct_from_others: Learned seed chooses a multiset summary in BOTH incidence directions; no destination-feature-conditioned ED message, static/dynamic discrepancy, or transported stalk geometry.
limitations: Only 9–25 nodes: graph-scale efficiency claims do not transfer.
Original graph node-classification embedding/head/objective replaced by provided evidence projection and original task readout.
Do not count AllDeepSets, PMA-only, or generic Set Transformer as additional distinct entries.
candidates.decision: ACCEPT as one complete fixed screening design

candidates.title: Equivariant Hypergraph Diffusion Neural Operators
candidates.corechain: m_e=sum_{u in e} phi(x_u); r_ve=rho(concat(x_v,m_e)); r_v=sum_{e containing v} r_ve; x_next=ReLU(psi((1-alpha)r_v+alpha*x0)). The recipient-conditioned incidence message and restart are retained.

exact_mapping.parameters: x0=ReLU(Linear128to128(projected_nodes)); one EquivSetConv shared for three iterations as author EquivSetGNN. phi128→128→128, rho256→128→128, psi128→128→128; ReLU hidden activations, sum in both directions, alpha=0.1, dropout=0, no normalization across nodes/batch.

candidates.why_meaningful: A Base head and a Gap head can receive different messages from the same evidence group. Source restart preserves the originally read evidence against repeated mixing. Tests conditional group disagreement without making extra memory requests.
candidates.distinct_from_others: Full sum–recipient-conditioned-return–restart iteration; not an AllSet shared edge broadcast or attention normalization.
limitations: Sum magnitudes depend on actual missing-modality edge sizes; this is intentional and must not silently become mean aggregation.
Retains a learned diffusion operator, not a numerical solver for an added energy loss.
Original input/classifier/task replaced; no claim of reproducing original hypergraph benchmarks.
candidates.decision: ACCEPT as one complete fixed screening design

candidates.title: Hyper-SAGNN: a self-attention based graph neural network for hypergraphs
candidates.corechain: For EACH hyperedge separately, compute context-independent static node embeddings and dynamic multihead attention embeddings excluding self. Retain separate static/dynamic position-wise networks and LayerNorm, then q_ve=(dynamic_ve-static_v)^2. This vector discrepancy, rather than attention alone, is the transferred core.

exact_mapping.graph: shared_mapping exactly; incidence occurrences of the same node share input but have different dynamic context
exact_mapping.parameters: One source EncoderLayer; both static and dynamic position-wise networks128→128→128; source residual/LN settings retained (dynamic residual, static no residual); separate output LayerNorm for each branch. diag_mask=True, dropout=0. Every edge has at least two nodes, so leave-self-out softmax always has an allowed key.
exact_mapping.readout: q_e=mean_{v in e}q_ve. q_H=mean eight same-head q_e; q_T=mean 1–3 evidence-type q_e. Concatenate original projected Local128,q_H128,q_T128; Linear384to128 then common zero-initialized Linear128to1600 Flat correction. Replace source scalar sigmoid hyperedge classifier/average probability with this task readout, not the static/dynamic discrepancy block.

candidates.why_meaningful: Directly measures whether an evidence component agrees with other components in its actual group while retaining its standalone representation. This is a disagreement-sensitive fusion mechanism, not merely attention under a famous model name.
candidates.distinct_from_others: Only candidate with separate static and leave-self-out contextual representations and elementwise squared discrepancy. It evaluates each predefined hyperedge rather than diffusing node states over graph rounds.
limitations: We are not predicting whether these constructed hyperedges exist; no negative-edge sampling or hyperedge labels.
A scalar probability from the original classifier is not a calibrated evidence reliability score; that output head is explicitly removed.
At zero Gap, discrepancy still compares Local with Base; no invented missing modality.
candidates.decision: ACCEPT as one complete core with explicitly replaced output task

candidates.title: Sheaf Hypergraph Networks
candidates.corechain: Predict a diagonal restriction map per node–hyperedge incidence from node and current edge features; construct lifted sheaf incidence; normalize, transport node fibers into each edge, aggregate and transport back; apply learned stalk/feature transforms and nonlinearity. Recompute maps at the next layer.

exact_mapping.parameters: Reshape learned node128 into mathematical fiber4×32, NOT spatial or memory-head coordinates. For each layer a_v=mean over four stalk rows; a_e=mean active a_v in edge; f_ve=tanh(Linear64to4([a_v,a_e])); F_ve=diag(f_ve). dynamic_sheaf=True, MLP_var2, special_head=False, dropout=0, left_proj=True, sym_block_norm, independent layer weights.
exact_mapping.operator: Pin author diagonal-convolution behavior including source order: H has incidence blocks F_ve (nd×Ed); D_(v,j)=sum_e f_ve,j^2, clamped at 1e-6 before inverse square root; B_(e,j)=|e|. Let R=D^-1/2. Source first computes X_pre=R Z, then Q=R H B^-1 H^T and output=(I+Q-2*blockdiag_node(Q)) X_pre+b. Equivalently A=R H B^-1 H^T R and P=R+A-2*blockdiag_node(A), output=PZ+b. The leading term is R, NOT I, because source pre-normalizes the input. Z=(I_n kron W_left4x4)X W_right32x32. ELU only after first layer, no extra residual. Dense construction follows this author-code convention; do not add source persistent shape caches.
exact_mapping.readout: Flatten final4×32 to128 per node; shared_mapping.common_readout

candidates.why_meaningful: Incidence-specific feature transport permits the same Base head to express different coordinates in head-compatibility and evidence-type groups. Tests agreement in learned group spaces without forcing all Base/Gap node vectors to be identical.
candidates.distinct_from_others: Structured per-incidence linear maps plus a normalized lifted diffusion operator, not scalar node attention. Diagonal stalk maps remain learned feature-dependent transport; do not count orthogonal/general variants as more papers.
limitations: The paper's displayed diagonal block definition, its expanded Eq.1, and author implementation do not transparently coincide for edges larger than two. This design explicitly pins the author-code P operator; do not assert the paper energy-decrease theorem for this adaptation.
The original code caches hyperedge attributes/shape-dependent identity masks; recompute them per utterance and layer because graph sizes vary.
Diagonal maps may approach zero; epsilon stabilization is an explicit adaptation.
File headers state MIT, but repository API did not establish a root license; prefer independent equation-based implementation and resolve license before vendoring source.
candidates.decision: ACCEPT runnable author-code-defined diagonal SheafHyperGNN variant; not the nonlinear HyperGCN variant
candidates.license: MIT stated in layers.py/models.py headers; repository-wide license unverified

verification_requirements: Compare each tiny-graph unmasked core against its pinned source equations/code, including both PMA directions, shared ED iterations, Hyper-SAGNN self exclusion and sheaf block-diagonal signs.

Assert inactive NaN invariance, no cross-utterance influence, permutation invariance within hyperedges, zero/no-history exact bypass, finite forward/backward and all relevant parameters updating after zero-output warmup.
Confirm actual 8×64 value-head semantics from current OSRAM source before wiring; learned head identities are not chronological coordinates.
No result or successful test is claimed by this research artifact.
